name: Freecell Solitaire
author: Addicting Games
description: Freecell Solitaire is a free solitaire game. Solitaire is not only a fun card game, it is a way of life. Just go right ahead and shuffle the deck and play your cards. These cards and how you play them are the story of who you are, in fact, this is the story of who everyone is. Your story is told in how you deal with a Joker or a Duece when what you really need is a King or a Jack. These small choices truly are the determining factors in who you become. Feeling stuck with hearts and diamonds when what you really want are spades and clubs? Then you truly know what it is to live life and die by the Freecell. Welcome to the world of Freecell Solitaire. There isn't a right way or a wrong way, only better and worse plays. Place your cards, shuffle your deck: all of it is a mirror image of who you are in your heart. Freecell Solitaire reflects us as people. Stack cards in alternating colors and increasing numbers or store them one at a time in your free cell discard piles. The choice is yours. Look for the patterns, make the right moves, and cash out a winner. Just like in real life.
